description: Review one vendor invoice: load it (with its purchase order and the vendor's other invoices) from the stores, run the deterministic checks in code (purchase-order match, duplicate lookup, amount tolerance, line sum), delegate the policy judgment to the invoice-reviewer subagent, then record the review and stamp the invoice. Returns the saved review. Recommends approve / hold / escalate / reject for a human approver; never pays or approves anything itself. Reports found: false when the invoice id is unknown.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to review, e.g. inv_brightline_0417.
